corrections.reason: Workflow 03 returns form_fields.filled as a list of field labels, not a scalar count. The evaluator now checks its length. The expected behavior remains zero filled fields for a public blank form. Four initial raw alerts were evaluator type errors, not production failures. Raw HTTP responses/results remain unchanged; rescored results are separate.

limitations: Intent expectations are generated candidate labels and not human-validated global ground truth.
Exact requested-fact matches assess only the requested official row/section; other claims and translated meaning require review.
Refusal markers alone are not refusal accuracy.
additional_diagnostics: Source-only replies are checked for a substantive body independently of found/citation flags.
Fresh empty-context cases are context tests, even without a preceding setup turn.
Known uncovered birth refusals are checked against the actual supported refusal contract; this is not a global refusal estimate.
Legal passage probes report retrieval only, separately from composed-answer citations.
Saved source-comparison reviews apply only when the observed-response hash matches; changed outputs require renewed review.
